cases.criterion: Three supplied PDFs extracted through native backend, actual page counts and source hashes, no retained PDFs
Current-model cited eight-section notes and evidenced concept pages from actual exported evidence
Whole-paper export coverage caps retain exact current chunk identities and disclose omissions
Wrong-paper citation, altered wrapper/hash, all-unknown document and stale source refused without published output
Identical import/view retry reuses exact snapshot; changed generated content is preserved and rejected
Metadata/source edits and archive remove records from current same-concept relationships; byte-identical restoration can recover current status
Selected three real papers receive per-paper evidence with complete cited cells and conditions
Wrong-paper citation, omitted/duplicate dimension or paper, unsupported comparable row and existing output refuse without modification
Generated Unicode/delimiter/linebreak text renders readable Markdown and source-page links resolve
Metadata edit/no-op/clear-tags preserves unknown metadata, source text and notes while old contexts become stale
Archive and exact retry then restore and exact retry preserve full file inventories and user-note bytes
Different-PDF replacement preserves old notes solely in archive, uses true new source digest and attribution link
Interrupted archive/restore/replace at owned stages recover deterministically without PDF after staged pair; conflicts retain good copies
Workspace lock coordinates native add and library changes; active lock refuses, no nested live lock deadlock
Deterministic create/reuse and streaming verify cover actual source/notes/knowledge/reports; restore byte-exact into absent destination
Old workflow sessions relocate into history byte-exact, fresh index/session preparation succeeds at restored root
Explicit outside-workspace Markdown output includes exact manifest mapping; stored external paths are never followed implicitly
Unsupported binary, unsafe/link/hardlink/unknown files, active or pending stages refuse without omission
Tampered/hash-mismatch/traversal/duplicate/casefold/oversize/ZIP metadata input refused before final destination exists
Restore of prior restored workspace preserves all history; existing destination and different existing backup remain untouched
Actual CLI commands/help/JSON error exit and repeated flags map to real backends; Skill keeps internal model documents out of normal user steps
Both locked Python 3.12 and 3.13 full suites on exact integrated stopped source; record module and interpreter provenance
Fresh isolated wheel runs installed console/module entrypoints against integrated source behavior
Exact allowlist review, unchanged dependencies/67 seed/upstream, serialized commit/push draftPR95 to integration, fresh four-job CI and exact-head acceptance

limitations: Engineering evidence only; no real Vault, provenance, scientific claim, human visual acceptance or merge.
